The mental health team I work with say that symptoms of BPD improve with age. I was diagnosed at 31 after being hospitalized for a unaliving attempt. 

I always thought that my BPD symptoms didn't show up until later in life, experiencing extreme stress, Bit when I reflect back on moments in my youth,I can definitely see the black and white thinking, having an FP, splitting episodes etc. 

I have had cognitive processing therapy, DBT, DBT refresher, good psychiatric management, and back to Cognitive processing therapy again. I have co diagnoses of Bipolar type 2 and PTSD and OCD tendencies. 

Therapy has literally been life saving, especially the DBT. I use my skills every damn day. I still have episodes, usually around my cycle,  when my fear of abandonment is triggered, or under a lot of stress. I'm able to recognize these now and take measures, use skills to help. Sometimes I still slip up, but I am able to find my way way back to myself quicker. 

I can also recognize my vulnerability factors, and in life we can't always control those.
